answer.answerText: No. The supplied evidence does not establish that ADR-043 caused the specific ExecutionConfiguration refactor delivered by Story 0042.

claims.text: Story 0042 delivered the ExecutionConfiguration change by adding TradingCalculatorService to PaperSettlementService.
